reason: In a normal week without deadline panic, I am not paying ₹12,990 upfront for software when my article clerks rotate every two to three years and training them feels like a waste of time. Even though the Trainee Laptop Shield addresses my constant anxiety about client data leaving on personal laptops, I would only test the free pilot first to see if the checklists truly run without supervision.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time unless the statutory blueprints work straight out of the box with zero handholding.
would_change_my_mind: Hands-on proof during the free pilot that a fresh article clerk can complete statutory filings with zero onboarding while the laptop shield reliably blocks client file downloads.
